description: Agent-first Google Analytics 4 CLI with typed Data/Admin/Funnel API coverage, one-call reports for channels, pages, funnels, anomalies, revenue, and health, plus a gated GA4 Admin write surface for key events, custom dimensions/metrics, and data streams.

novel_features.name: Health/Doctor
novel_features.description: health/doctor distinguishes token/API errors from property-level GA4 access grant failures

novel_features.name: Channels,
novel_features.description: channels, sources, top-pages, revenue produce curated acquisition/ecommerce tables

novel_features.name: Compare
novel_features.description: compare calculates period-over-period deltas and percentage changes in one call

novel_features.name: Whats-Changed
novel_features.description: whats-changed scans movers across channels, source/medium, and landing pages

novel_features.name: Funnel
novel_features.description: funnel wraps v1alpha runFunnelReport for named event sequences

novel_features.name: Agent-Context
novel_features.description: agent-context emits structured tool metadata for agents

novel_features.name: Key-Events
novel_features.description: key-events lists, creates, patches, and deletes GA4 key events (conversions) through the Admin API

novel_features.name: Custom-Dimensions
novel_features.description: custom-dimensions lists, creates, and archives GA4 custom dimensions

novel_features.name: Custom-Metrics
novel_features.description: custom-metrics lists, creates, and archives GA4 custom metrics

novel_features.name: Data-Streams
novel_features.description: data-streams manages the full data stream lifecycle with an updateMask built only from the flags actually passed

novel_features.name: Admin
novel_features.description: admin is a generic Admin API escape hatch over any method/path with --body, --update-mask, and --api v1beta|v1alpha for resources such as accessBindings that exist only in v1alpha

novel_features.name: Destructive-Write-Gate
novel_features.description: destructive writes require --yes to appear on the command line; --agent implies --yes for prompts but deliberately does not authorize destruction

catalog_description: Agent-first Google Analytics 4 CLI with typed Data/Admin/Funnel API coverage, one-call reports for channels, pages, funnels, anomalies, revenue, and health, plus a gated GA4 Admin write surface for key events, custom dimensions/metrics, and data streams.
